description: This file defines the IdempotencyTokenMiddleware class within the AWS SDK for PHP, which provides functionality to generate and insert UUIDv4 idempotency tokens into API requests using configurable or system-generated random byte sources.

classes.name: Aws\IdempotencyTokenMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that populates request parameters with idempotency tokens (UUIDv4) for AWS SDK operations.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware wrapper that injects idempotency tokens into commands.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with the next handler, service, and optional bytes generator.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Callable method that inserts the UUIDv4 token into the command if required, then proceeds with the handler chain.

methods.name: getUuidV4
methods.description: Generates a UUIDv4 string from 16 bytes of pseudo-random data, setting appropriate UUID version bits.

methods.name: findCompatibleRandomSource
methods.description: Detects and returns a suitable system function for generating random bytes, or null if none are available.
